title: Tensor extension computes sections of the affine chart model under an affine morphism
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], $U$ an affine open of $Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $V=i^{-1}U$, $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, and $B=\Gamma(Z,V)$ with the $A$-algebra structure from $i$. For every $A$-module $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $T$ be the functor associating a sheaf on Spec A, restricting along the chart isomorphism, pushing forward along U to Y, and applying tensor pullback along i [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section], [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists a $B$-linear equivalence $e:B\otimes_A M\simeq\Gamma(V,T(M))$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], such that $e(b\otimes m)=b\cdot\mathrm{selfTorAffineSection}(i,U,M,m)$ for every $b\in B$ and $m\in M$ [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. No quotient-ring, conormal, or exterior-power assumption is made.

proof.text: Use the normalized affine chart section equivalence to identify M with the chart-pushforward sections on U. Its restriction to U is quasi-coherent; no assertion about global quasi-coherence is used.

Apply the locally quasi-coherent affine pullback section equivalence to the chart pushforward C. Tensor the chart equivalence by the B-linear identity of B using AlgebraTensorModule.congr, then compose with the pullback section equivalence.

Evaluate on b tensor m using the two pure-tensor formulas. After unfolding selfTorAffineSection, the resulting adjunction-unit section is definitionally that section. This proves the stated normalization. All equivalences include the empty affine-open and zero-module cases.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01I9(1), with the chart normalization of Tag 01I7 and adjunction unit of Tag 0096; proved both intermediate comparisons and assembled the tensor equivalence in Lean.

mathlib_searches.query: Sections of the pullback of an associated module from an affine open are the tensor extension of the module, compatibly with the pullback adjunction unit
An affine morphism pulls back the pushforward of an associated module from an affine open; sections on the inverse image identify with tensor product and the adjunction unit sends m to one tensor m

from.place: Affine conormal wedge chart calculation in finite duality: sections of the pulled-back associated exterior module, after the algebraic conormal identification.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_selfTor_affine_tensor_sections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom i]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (M : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := (i.app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ e : (Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⊗[Γ(Y, U.1)] M) ≃ₗ[Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)]
        (T.obj M).val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      ∀ (b : Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (m : M),
        e (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, U.1)] m) = b • selfTorAffineSection i U M m
